reviews.t: another solid epilator from Braun (plus no more underarm bumps!)

reviews.x: Very misleading in the photos.  Look at the 5th photo in the all media.  It shows more heads and attachments.  you don't get these attachments with this device. reviews.t: Works really well, although don't delude yourself that it won't hurt.
reviews.x: I'm a tweezing/waxing maniac. Although it does hurt to wax, it doesn't suck as much as having to shave all the time, so I prefer it over shaving. The downside to that is that it is so expensive. In my town, an underarm wax can cost $22 plus tip, and since the hair will grow back at different times you may end up wishing for another wax just a week later. You also have to wait until it's long enough too. Since I was tired of the cost of waxing and I don't mind the pain of waxing or plucking, I th

reviews.t: Excellent Epilator With A Price Premium for the Exfoliation Brush
reviews.x: My wife has used a number of Braun Epilators over the years.  Her most recent one was a Braun Series 7- 7181 [[ASIN:B0077PLNB6 Braun Series 7-7181 Silk Epil Wet & Dry Epilator 1 Count]] that proved to be a 5 star product.  This Braun Se7921 is identical to the 7181 except that it comes with a brush head attachment for exfoliation.  The price is about $20-30 dollars more than the 7181.  So is the extra cost worth it?  While the brush attachment does leave the skin on her legs looking more smooth,

reviews.t: Exfoliated well but that's about it
reviews.x: This worked perfectly as an exfoliator (for body, not face---it's too harsh for the face) but with the epilator I can go over the same area 10 times before one single hair is finally removed. And even so, when it would finally remove a hair, it would only kinda cut it, not totally remove it. For me, it is just too time consuming. Although it's a great concept, I don't find that any of these products work as well as shaving. I also find that you have to let your hair grow in the length of a cavem

reviews.t: Utter torture, but you're skin will love you
reviews.x: I have naturally curly hair so I'm highly prone to ingrown hairs. Additionally, I have very sensitive skin. Shaving would leave my legs covered in red bumps the first day and I can't even imagine shaving again within the week.  I've tried waxing my own legs and armpit, but it's just hard to do your own armpits and I find waxing to be expensive and time consuming for legs.  So I went searching for other options. I decided to try an epilator. I started with my armpit (that may have not been the sm

reviews.t: Works well, if you're careful and use it right.
reviews.x: It works pretty well.  It's more painful to use than the Emjoi Seal Wet/Dry Epilator, however it seems to get my skin a lot smoother than the other one does.  I've found it works well dry, or in the shower, with soapy skin.  (DO NOT USE ON DAMP SKIN!!!)  It gets my skin fairly smooth, but not quite as smooth as shaving.  Really, my only complaint about this item (and the reason I'm knocking 2 stars off), is that it doesn't stop if it catches the skin, like the Emjoi Seal Wet/Dry Epilator does.

reviews.t: does really work
reviews.x: It doesn't work very well. It does not get ALL the hair off, so its kind of worthless. Also, if you don't use the brush head, your legs will be itchy with a bunch of ingrown hairs.

reviews.t: First Time Epilator User
reviews.x: This review comes from a first time epilator user. I did some research beforehand to try to understand what it is that this does. They are tiny tweezer-like arms that glide over the skin and pull hair from the root. I have tweezed before and know how painful that is. I bought this for facial hair removal. It works like intended, but not all my hairs are coarse and need to be plucked. This attempts to pick up each hair which is painful when only half need to be. I tried to ease into it and use it

reviews.t: I See The Light...
reviews.x: This is my second epilator from Amazon in a year. I got it because it has a wet/dry option and an exfoliator attachment unlike my first, an Emjoi model. This one is definitely more gentle but also less effective. It takes more passes and more time than the Emjoi model.   You should know a few things about epilating before investing in an expensive model if you've never tried it before. Firstly, six weeks of smoothness is a total lark. It must be done once a week to avoid unnecessary pain and pee

reviews.t: Better than many other epilators for smooth skin
reviews.x: I've tried a couple of different types of epilators over the past 15-20 years.  While I was usually happy enough with the results, I rarely used them since it always seemed like you had to wait until the hair got long enough for the unit to grip the hair in order to yank it out.  And rarely did I really want the hair on my legs to reach that amount of stubble.  Not to mention the pain that is involved with epilators.  Yes, I am a weenie.  This model of the Braun Silk Epil removes much shorter ha

reviews.t: Great Product
reviews.x: I got tired of going to waxing appointments and found the Braun Epilator works great at home.  I use mine in the shower.  I found if I use the epilator more frequently than the once a month waxing appointments, the hair removal was not as painful and I don't need to suffer thru hair grow out.  I also use the brush to wash my face.  It's great at removing dead skin after using Retin A.

reviews.t: All that pain for what?
reviews.x: I have coarse stubble since I'm Italian, and I was hoping this product would help remove hair on my legs, armpits, panty line etc. but even though it put me through a bit of annoying pain, I hardly got any results even after going over the same spots multiple times. I'm not sure I will keep the item since it probably won't be of much use to me.

reviews.t: Good but not great
reviews.x: I've been using this type of product for hair removal for a number of years now (maybe 5?) so I have some experience with these kinds of devices. I long since stopped shaving my underarms because the stubble grows in faster than a man's 5 o'clock shadow and is painful and this kind of hair removal solves that problem. As far as pain goes it's not so much that I'm used to it as it is that hairs have different growth speeds and once you're on a roll using it regularly you don't have that many comi

reviews.t: Pretty sure it's just breaking the fine hairs off.
reviews.x: Being new to epilators I bought one and was underwhelmed, so I thought I'd try a few more and see if I could get any improvement. Enter the Braun Silk Epi, which is very highly rated so I thought I'd give it a try. At first I thought it was amazing, less pain than the first one I tried, but I noticed the fine hairs weren't actually being plucked, they were just shorter. Great, that's not what I'm going for here. Not to mention the fact that there's only the epilator head, and the brush head. The

reviews.t: Kindest torture device . . . I mean . . . epilator I've owned
reviews.x: I have owned a few epilators, though not many.  I should start out by saying that epilation isn't exactly my favorite hair removal method.  It is time-consuming (you have to go over areas several times), uncomfortable (don't let anyone lie to you), and if you neglect to exfoliate, you will end up with ugly, painful, ingrown hairs, which can even scar if you don't take care of them properly.  However, there is something very attractive about a hair removal method that you can do at home, won't co

reviews.t: Braun Silk Epil
reviews.x: I have been epilating me legs for a very long time & have tried several different epilators over the years. I owned one of the earlier Silk Epil models before & was very happy with it. Since I purchased that one in Europe I was unable to use it in the US which resulted in me purchasing a Remington epilator which I have been using for about two years now. I was never really happy with it, so when it started to give out on me I decided it was time to purchase a new one. I used the Braun Silk Epil

reviews.t: Love the Exfoliating brush!
reviews.x: I have the Braun 7181 model and am a huge fan of exfoliation. If you're new, please know that it hurts the most in the beginning but does get better with each epilation. The battery lasts a little over 45 min. and charges quickly. It has the same light like in previous model and is really helpful to see the tiny hairs. The hair growth does lessen over time and the skin fells really smooth as long as you take care of the ingrown hair. That said, my big complaint with the previous model were the i

reviews.t: Excellent!!!
reviews.x: Meets and exceedes expectations! Easy to use/clean/store. The two speed settings allow for gentler or efficient hair removal. The first use hurts plenty (of course), but if you maintain regularly it's incredibly mild. The exfoliating body brush makes it easy to keep ingrown hairs at bay. The light allows easy sighting of missed hairs and which direction they're going. Can be used with or without the guard (be careful either way though). Is waterproof, which makes it easier to groom more sensitiv

reviews.t: "It hurts so good!"
reviews.x: I hate myself for buying this, but I don't regret it one bit. While the concept sounds like some medieval torture device, I must say, it's worth it. 100%.  I bought this because I was sick and tired of paying insane prices for razor heads. I have extremely sensitive skin, so I always had to splurge and get the ~16-18 dollar packs of razors with some kind of soap on the razor head (Generally the Venus + Olay mix). Every time the soap ran out, I had to put on a new head - I was pretty much just th

reviews.t: Weak power, weak massaging brush, doesn't pluck hairs from the root
reviews.x: This is my first experience using an epilator, and I used this for my underarms. reviews.t: Best Epilator Braun ever made!
reviews.x: I have been living on Braun Epilators since I was a teenager. This new advanced one is pretty awesome, especially the fact that it can be used during your shower. I shave my arms and legs with it. I also love the defoliator brush, I use it on my elbows, knees, and underarms while showering coz i suffer from skin darkness in these areas.....I simply love this epilator and would definitely recommend it.

reviews.t: It hurt like hell, left "razor" burn
reviews.x: It hurt like hell, left "razor" burn, and the hair was stubbly. I also tried this under my arms and my skin went nuts and broke out in a rash. I do have sensitive skin, so this product isn't for me.

claims.text: Several reviewers report that the epilator struggles to remove hair effectively, requiring many passes over the same area with poor results.
Reviewers frequently note that the device is painful to use, though some consider the results worth it.
Multiple reviewers complain that the US version lacks the attachments shown in photos and included in other regions, calling it misleading.
Several reviewers praise the results, saying it leaves skin smooth and helps with ingrown hairs and bumps.
Some reviewers note the wet/dry capability works well in the shower but warn against using it on damp skin.
